newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Ashton bids for Australian Diamond.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Ashton bids for Australian Diamond.

text.p: Argyle diamond mine partner Ashton Mining Ltd said on Friday it would offer A$1.40 per share for the shares in Australian Diamond Exploration NL it does not already own.
Ashton Mining already has a 77.6 percent stake in Australian Diamond (ADEX), which has as its main asset a 44.5 percent holding in the Northern Territory's Merlin diamond project.
ADEX shares last traded at A$1.30 each on Thursday.
The Ashton offer is conditional on receipt of all ADEX's issued ordinary shares, as well as foreign investment approval.
Ashton is 46.95 percent owned by Malaysia Mining Corp Bhd .
Its bid for ADEX values the diamond explorer at A$62.1 million.

Ashton chief executive John Robinson said the Merlin project partners, which included Aberfoyle Ltd, had decided to proceed to the final feasibility stage. Ashton would have 77.5 percent of project if its bid was successful.
"The current project structure, involving co-investment with a 77.6 percent owned subsidiary, is both confusing to the market and administratively inefficient," Robinson said.
"Ashton provides ADEX with all of its staffing requirements for the management of its various operations as ADEX has no employees," Robinson said.
He said ADEX was a low turnover stock and the company would require funds for the development of Merlin and exploration activities if it remained independent.
